audience: affiliate managers who run referral programs and approve affiliates in LeadDyno

useCases.title: Review new affiliate applications
useCases.text: Filter affiliates by name, email or created time. Open an applicant to read its status and referrer.

useCases.title: Approve or reject a pending affiliate
useCases.text: Check the affiliate first. Then approve it so it can earn commissions, or reject the application.

useCases.title: Check commission totals for a period
useCases.text: Get the commission counts and costs for a date range, per affiliate or note. List the commissions behind the totals.

useCases.title: Trace purchases that affiliates referred
useCases.text: List purchases in a time range, optionally only affiliate-referred ones, including cancellations. Open one for its amount and referral source.

useCases.title: Find an affiliate or lead by code or email
useCases.text: Look up an affiliate by affiliate or coupon code, or by email. Look up a lead by its email address.
